tools.name: grant_covenant
tools.description:
Grant an agent a covenant: an explicit lease of authority. scopes support
    wildcards ('payments.*', '*'); budget_minor is the total spend ceiling in
    minor units; expires_at is ISO-8601. Returns the covenant_id.

tools.name: check_act
tools.description:
Check (and if allowed, record) a proposed act against a covenant.
    Deny-by-default. Idempotent on act_id — retries never double-consume
    budget. Every check lands on the audit chain.

tools.name: revoke_covenant
tools.description: Revoke a covenant immediately and terminally. All subsequent checks deny.

tools.name: covenant_status
tools.description: Current state, consumed/remaining budget, and check count.

tools.name: verify_audit
tools.description: Verify the tamper-evident audit chain of allowed/denied acts.

tools.name: list_covenants
tools.description:
List covenants, optionally filtered by state (ACTIVE|REVOKED|EXPIRED)
    and/or the bound agent.

tools.name: describe_agent
tools.description:
Describe this agent: name, version, purpose, every action it supports
    and the inputs each one takes. Read-only and free; call it first to learn
    how to use this server.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "describe_agent" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet:
before: "Fleet-standard self-description." → after: "Describe this agent: name, version, purpose, every action it supports
    and the inputs each one takes. Read-only and free; call it first to learn
    how to use this server."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
